clips.end_words: Those are really your three best sweeteners
clips.send: A health-conscious friend sends this to someone who just switched to stevia after reading a scary headline - anger at being misled by a thin study.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau breaks down a scary headline: a study claiming stevia and monk fruit more than double the risk of blood clots.

His read after digging into it: the study tracked only 10 people, and the "stevia" and "monk fruit" tested weren't the pure versions - they were blends mixed with other ingredients off a shelf.

His actual rule: organic raw cane sugar, beet sugar, and raw honey (never boiled) are the three sweeteners he trusts. Stevia and monk fruit, only in moderation.

What's actually in the sweetener on your counter?

#kevintrudeau #sweeteners #stevia #nutrition #healthyeating #wbdaily

clips.send: Someone sends this to a parent who complains about joint pain every day - hope, a reason to try water before another pill.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau points to a doctor named Darrell Stoddard, who worked with over 30,000 chronic pain patients.

His finding: most of them were simply dehydrated. Once they drank enough water and got properly hydrated, the pain eased - joint pain, back pain, headaches.

Kevin's own rule: eight glasses of pure water a day, one or two of them first thing in the morning, more if you drink a lot of coffee.

Your body is 70% water. When was the last time you drank a full glass that wasn't coffee, tea or juice?

#kevintrudeau #hydration #water #chronicpain #naturalhealth #wbdaily
